card.title: How To Fix an iPhone XS That Randomly Restarts

source.title: How To Fix an iPhone XS That Randomly Restarts

claims.statement: iPhone XS / XS Max Missing sensors TG0B/TG0V = battery path: check Q3200/Q3201 and the I2C0_SMC_TO_GG lines; Prs0 or Mic1 = charging port flex.

procedure: TG0B/TG0V: battery, Q3200/Q3201, gas gauge lines.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
